title: Tree reconstruction analysis: formal proofs and numerical experiments
description: Formal proofs and numerical experiments accompanying Average-Case Comparison Counts and Limit Distributions of Binary-Tree Construction from Inorder–Preorder Sequences. Contains Lean 4 / Mathlib and Rocq developments, proof audits, and independent numerical cross-checks for the Mäkinen and Glück–Yokoyama algorithms under the uniform Catalan model. See REPRODUCING.md and docs/RESULTS.md for scope and verification instructions.
